content.value_statement: Complex debugging needs more than one review angle. This skill structures code review across security, architecture, performance, and quality perspectives.
actual_capabilities: Defines when to use a multi-agent review workflow.
Maps review targets to specialist agent roles.
Outlines parallel and sequential review strategies.
Describes result synthesis and conflict resolution steps.
Provides validation concepts for review quality.
limitations: Does not include executable review automation.
Uses pseudocode examples instead of a working framework.
Requires the user to provide target files or project context.
Does not replace project-specific testing or expert review.

use_cases.title: Debug a production issue
use_cases.description: Coordinate quality, security, and performance review angles before choosing fixes.

use_cases.title: Review a pull request
use_cases.description: Route a change through specialist review perspectives and consolidate the findings.

use_cases.title: Assess architecture risk
use_cases.description: Combine architecture, compliance, and deployment readiness feedback into one prioritized report.

prompt_templates.title: Start a focused review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this target with a multi-agent debugging workflow: [path or summary]. Focus on likely root causes and clear next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate specialist agents
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for multiple review angles.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a structured review of [target]. Use security, architecture, performance, and code quality perspectives. Synthesize the most important findings.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve conflicting findings
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request after several reviews disagree.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these review findings: [findings]. Identify conflicts, weigh the evidence, and produce one prioritized remediation plan.

prompt_templates.title: Design a repeatable workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for team process design.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a repeatable multi-agent review process for [project type]. Include routing rules, review phases, validation checks, and output format.

output_examples.input: Review an API service that has intermittent timeout errors.
output_examples.output: A synthesized review that separates likely root causes, performance risks, security concerns, and recommended validation steps.

output_examples.input: Assess a pull request that changes authentication and caching behavior.
output_examples.output: A prioritized report that combines security, architecture, and performance observations with clear owner actions.

output_examples.input: Create a review workflow for a microservices migration.
output_examples.output: A staged process with specialist review roles, sequencing guidance, conflict handling, and quality checks.

best_practices: Provide the target files, error symptoms, and recent changes before review.
Ask for separate specialist perspectives before synthesis.
Validate recommendations with tests, logs, or domain experts.
anti_patterns: Do not use the workflow when the task is unrelated to code review.
Do not treat pseudocode examples as production automation.
Do not accept synthesized findings without checking project evidence.

faq.question: Does this skill run code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides review orchestration guidance and pseudocode concepts only.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide target files, repository context, error symptoms, constraints, and success criteria.

faq.question: Can it replace manual code review?
faq.answer: No. It helps structure review work, but humans should verify important decisions.

faq.question: Is it focused only on security?
faq.answer: No. It also covers architecture, performance, compliance, quality, and synthesis.

faq.question: What output should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect a prioritized review summary with specialist findings and recommended next actions.
